vlae.blok: Waar ons hulpbronne veral ontgin word (kaart)
vlae.teks: Merk die gebiede waar die vyf hulpbronne veral ontgin word
vlae.rede: The map block says 'vyf hulpbronne' but then names six (goud, platinum, steenkool, ystererts, mangaan, diamante); it may mean five groups, but whether the number or the grouping is intended cannot be settled without guessing, so it is flagged rather than changed.
